Placeholder for real **EB tresos** project fixtures (`.xdm` and related EB project
files), following the fixture layout
`tests/fixtures/nxp/eb/<family>/<project>/`.

**Reserved.** The EB tresos backend reuses the same intent, diagnostics, asset,
and test concepts as the S32 ConfigTools `.mex` backend ([`../ds/`](../ds/))
with its own document core, writer, and vendor validation (EB tresos, same gate
semantics). Populate this directory when that backend is scheduled on the
[roadmap](../../../../docs/roadmaps/rtd-config-roadmap.md).
